## Ileum

```{r mm12 associated, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# get metadatas
ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta <- metadata[metadata$age == "Young" & 
                                     metadata$tissue == "ileum" &
                                     metadata$group == "Solo",]
liver_spf_gf_mm12_meta <- metadata[metadata$age == "Young" & 
                                     metadata$tissue == "liver" &
                                     metadata$group == "Solo",]

# get expression data
ileum_exprs <- ileum_normed_dat_corrected[,ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta$sample_id]

# aggregate on symbols
geneid2genename <- data.frame(gene_id = ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$gene_id,
                              gene_name = ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$gene_name)
rownames(geneid2genename) <- geneid2genename$gene_id
to_agg <- geneid2genename[rownames(ileum_exprs),]

ileum_exprs <- aggregate(ileum_exprs, by = list(to_agg$gene_name), FUN = "mean") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Group.1")


mm12_gf <- subset(ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05)
mm12_spf <- subset(ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05)

# take the intersection
mm12_up <- intersect(rownames(subset(mm12_gf, subset = log2FoldChange > 0)),
                     rownames(subset(mm12_spf, subset = log2FoldChange < 0)))
                     
mm12_down <- intersect(rownames(subset(mm12_gf, subset = log2FoldChange < 0)),
                     rownames(subset(mm12_spf, subset = log2FoldChange > 0)))

pathways <- fgsea::gmtPathways( "/well/powrie/shared/mm_msigdb/m5.go.v2023.1.Mm.symbols.gmt.txt")
pathways <- pathways[grep("GOBP_", names(pathways))]
fgsea_mm12_up <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_up, universe = ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$gene_name)

fgsea_mm12_down <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_down, universe = ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$gene_name)

rownames(ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta) <- ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta$sample_id
featurebox(as.data.frame(ileum_exprs),
           metadata = ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta,
           features = unlist(fgsea_mm12_up[1,]$overlapGenes)[1:6],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("export.dir/stress_response.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)


featurebox(as.data.frame(ileum_exprs),
           metadata = ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta,
           features = unlist(fgsea_mm12_down[1,]$overlapGenes)[1:6],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("export.dir/cell_cycle.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)

# write out the mm12 only expression for correlations later
mm12_samples <- metadata$sample_id[metadata$status == "MM12" & metadata$tissue == "ileum"]
write.table(data.frame(gene = rownames(ileum_exprs), ileum_exprs[,mm12_samples]),
            file = "export.dir/mm12_ileum_exprs.tsv",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)


```

```{r coherent sets, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

stress_response <- c("Hif1a", "Ppp1r15a", "Atf3", "Ddit3")
cell_cycle <- c("Cdc20", "Cdca2", "Top2a", "Mki67")

gois_mm12 <- c(stress_response, cell_cycle)

for (i in 1:length(gois_mm12)){
  genename <- gois_mm12[i]
  filename <- paste0("export.dir/ileum_", genename, "mm12", ".pdf")
  featurebox(as.data.frame(ileum_exprs),
           metadata = ileum_spf_gf_mm12_meta,
           features = gois_mm12[i],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
    facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
    ggsave(file = filename, height = 2.5, width = 2.5)
}

```


## Correlate diffs in GF and SPF

### Ileum

```{r correlation of fold changes, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

genes <- intersect(rownames(ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12),
                   rownames(ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12))

to_cor_fold <- data.frame(gene = genes,
                          GF = ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12[genes,]$log2FoldChange,
                          SPF = ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12[genes,]$log2FoldChange)

to_cor_fold$sig <- ifelse(to_cor_fold$gene %in% mm12_up, "up", NA)
to_cor_fold$sig <- ifelse(to_cor_fold$gene %in% mm12_down, "down", to_cor_fold$sig)

to_cor_fold$label <- ifelse(to_cor_fold$GF > 2 & -to_cor_fold$SPF > 2,
                            to_cor_fold$gene,
                            NA)

ggplot(to_cor_fold, aes(x = GF, y = -SPF, color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue3", "red3"), na.value = "snow2") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("export.dir/ileum_scatter_mm12_associated.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```

## Liver

```{r mm12 associated liver, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

mm12_gf_liver <- subset(liver_res_gf_vs_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05)
mm12_spf_liver <- subset(liver_res_spf_vs_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05)

# take the intersection
mm12_liver_up <- intersect(rownames(subset(mm12_gf_liver, subset = log2FoldChange > 0)),
                     rownames(subset(mm12_spf_liver, subset = log2FoldChange < 0)))
                     
mm12_liver_down <- intersect(rownames(subset(mm12_gf_liver, subset = log2FoldChange < 0)),
                     rownames(subset(mm12_spf_liver, subset = log2FoldChange > 0)))

fgsea_mm12_liver_up <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_liver_up, universe = rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_gf))

fgsea_mm12_liver_down <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_liver_down, universe = rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_gf))

rownames(liver_spf_gf_mm12_meta) <- liver_spf_gf_mm12_meta$sample_id
featurebox(as.data.frame(liver_exprs),
           metadata = liver_spf_gf_mm12_meta,
           features = unlist(fgsea_mm12_liver_up[1,]$overlapGenes)[1:6],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = liver_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

featurebox(as.data.frame(liver_exprs),
           metadata = liver_spf_gf_mm12_meta,
           features = unlist(fgsea_mm12_liver_down[1,]$overlapGenes)[1:6],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = liver_colours)  +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

mm12_samples_liver <- metadata$sample_id[metadata$status == "MM12" & metadata$tissue == "liver"]
write.table(data.frame(gene = rownames(liver_exprs), liver_exprs[,mm12_samples_liver]),
            file = "export.dir/mm12_liver_exprs.tsv",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)

```


### Liver correlations

```{r correlation of fold changes liver, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

genes <- intersect(rownames(liver_res_gf_vs_mm12),
                   rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_mm12))

to_cor_fold_liver <- data.frame(gene = genes,
                          GF = liver_res_gf_vs_mm12[genes,]$log2FoldChange,
                          SPF = liver_res_spf_vs_mm12[genes,]$log2FoldChange)

to_cor_fold_liver$sig <- ifelse(to_cor_fold_liver$gene %in% mm12_liver_up, "up", NA)
to_cor_fold_liver$sig <- ifelse(to_cor_fold_liver$gene %in% mm12_liver_down, "down", to_cor_fold_liver$sig)

to_cor_fold_liver$label <- ifelse(to_cor_fold_liver$GF > 2 & -to_cor_fold_liver$SPF > 2,
                            to_cor_fold$gene,
                            NA)

ggplot(to_cor_fold_liver, aes(x = GF, y = -SPF, color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue3", "red3"), na.value = "snow2") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(label = to_cor_fold_liver$label, max.overlaps = 50, color = "black")

```

## Correlations between up and down genes in the ileum

```{r corrs, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

to_cor_mm12 <- data.frame(sample = colnames(ileum_exprs),
                          Ppp1r15a = unlist(ileum_exprs["Ppp1r15a",]),
                          Hif1a = unlist(ileum_exprs["Hif1a",]),
                          Vegfa = unlist(ileum_exprs["Vegfa",]),
                          Cdc20 = unlist(ileum_exprs["Cdc20",]),
                          Kif22 = unlist(ileum_exprs["Kif22",]),
                          Lamp1, = unlist(ileum_exprs["Lamp1",]),
                          status = ileum_metadata_spf_mm12[colnames(ileum_exprs),]$status)
                          

ggplot(to_cor_mm12, aes(x = Cdc20, y = Kif22, color = status)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  stat_cor()


```



# write pathway results


```{r fora pathway results, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}


fgsea_mm12_up <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_up, universe = ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$gene_name)
fgsea_mm12_up$type <- "Genes_Upregulated"

fgsea_mm12_down <- fgsea::fora(pathways, mm12_down, universe = ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$gene_name)
fgsea_mm12_down$type <- "Genes_Downregulated"

fgsea_res_mm12 <- bind_rows(fgsea_mm12_up, fgsea_mm12_down)

fgsea_res_mm12 <- fgsea_res_mm12[fgsea_res_mm12$padj < 0.05,]

for (i in 1:nrow(fgsea_res_mm12)){
  fgsea_res_mm12[i,]$overlapGenes<- paste(unlist(fgsea_res_mm12[i,]$overlapGenes), collapse = ", ")[[1]]
}
fgsea_res_mm12$overlapGenes<- unlist(fgsea_res_mm12$overlapGenes)

write.table(fgsea_res_mm12,
            file = "export.dir/fora_mm12_distinct.tsv",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)

```
